scope: Nov21/22 production official-source observation and handoff; not forecast market acceptance
extraction_policy: Static transitive diagnostics import closure of 7 source entry modules, all top-level functions registered and locked by source Git blob; newly imported modules and newly added functions require inventory expansion. Class-method and runtime dynamic imports are independently declared separate pending scopes. Sunday source refresh: 29 modules / 103 top-level functions enumerated; five newly found functions and six changed source blobs explicitly reopened without any presumed risk closure or real-JRA verification. Nov22 source v2: independently re-lock changed SP discovery and explicitly leave SP all12 archive stage outside fully reviewed FMEA closure. Live release acceptance remains source-only, not complete model certification. Nov22 official app.jra.jp SP repair: three existing critical source modules byte-locked to inspected candidate; 29 registered critical modules retain open and incomplete FMEA; no success assertions for JRA live market response.

risks.name: PC/SP race identity drift
risks.failure_mode: PC observes largest available race; SP hard-codes race 12. Cross-lane equivalence is not guaranteed.
risks.required_evidence: separate negative test + actual source bytes or documented simulated failure + independent recheck

risks.name: SP link candidate overfilter
risks.failure_mode: Matching requires token embedding 12+day and literal Kyoto label; actual official SP link format is unverified.
risks.required_evidence: separate negative test + actual source bytes or documented simulated failure + independent recheck

risks.name: SP navigation horizon
risks.failure_mode: Only three SP pages can be followed; real menus may be deeper or multi-branch.
risks.required_evidence: separate negative test + actual source bytes or documented simulated failure + independent recheck

risks.name: Prestart cut-off not bound to race
risks.failure_mode: UTC source time and scheduled start time do not have an independently authenticated joint proof.
risks.required_evidence: separate negative test + actual source bytes or documented simulated failure + independent recheck

risks.name: Markets not qualified for prediction

risks.required_evidence: separate negative test + actual source bytes or documented simulated failure + independent recheck

risks.name: No common cross-job pacing

risks.required_evidence: separate negative test + actual source bytes or documented simulated failure + independent recheck

risks.name: Partial source with unexpected file not sealed

risks.required_evidence: separate negative test + actual source bytes or documented simulated failure + independent recheck

risks.name: Crash before seal step kills artifact salvage
risks.failure_mode: SIGKILL, runner failure or timeout can terminate job before upload-always recovery completes.
risks.required_evidence: separate negative test + actual source bytes or documented simulated failure + independent recheck

risks.name: Per-run duplicate checks miss reservation races
risks.failure_mode: Concurrent schedule and dispatch may inspect history before both are visible; GitHub job concurrency group is day-dependent.
risks.required_evidence: separate negative test + actual source bytes or documented simulated failure + independent recheck

risks.name: Workflow scheduling delay past window
risks.failure_mode: Cron does not guarantee starting before hardcoded UTC window closes.
risks.required_evidence: separate negative test + actual source bytes or documented simulated failure + independent recheck

risks.name: Cross-run evidence is not durable

risks.required_evidence: separate negative test + actual source bytes or documented simulated failure + independent recheck

risks.name: Day21 handoff does not open encrypted artifact
risks.failure_mode: Triage classifies success by artifact metadata without decrypting source originals, SHA and observed market content.
risks.required_evidence: separate negative test + actual source bytes or documented simulated failure + independent recheck

risks.name: Day22 promoted code has only passing CI, no root fix proof
risks.failure_mode: Matching SHA and green CI do not establish that specific day21 root cause has been fixed and independently checked.
risks.required_evidence: separate negative test + actual source bytes or documented simulated failure + independent recheck

risks.name: SP odds navigation original omission
risks.failure_mode: Postflight validates core SP pages but not every SP odds navigation intermediate original and receipt field.; source improvement under active regression and not yet independently signed
risks.required_evidence: separate negative test + actual source bytes or documented simulated failure + independent recheck

risks.name: PC odds navigation original omission
risks.failure_mode: Postflight does not independently account for every PC odds navigation HTML and its recorded hash or UTC.; source improvement under active regression and not yet independently signed
risks.required_evidence: separate negative test + actual source bytes or documented simulated failure + independent recheck

risks.name: Partial capture labels zero-request incorrectly
risks.failure_mode: Pre-HTTP stop is inferred from absent source directory, but a request could begin before folder creation or persist outside expected path.
risks.required_evidence: separate negative test + actual source bytes or documented simulated failure + independent recheck

risks.name: Third-party dependency version drift
risks.failure_mode: Runtime installs bounded but unpinned parser/crypto dependency versions which can change between simulated and weekend runs.
risks.required_evidence: separate negative test + actual source bytes or documented simulated failure + independent recheck

risks.name: Cross-day handoff API inaccessible or incomplete
risks.failure_mode: GitHub list APIs are restricted by pagination, permissions and transient error handling; cannot assume retrieval of all jobs/artifacts.
risks.required_evidence: separate negative test + actual source bytes or documented simulated failure + independent recheck

risks.name: PC observed largest available race, ignores earlier race markets
risks.failure_mode: Observer prefers highest numbered meeting link regardless of whether pre-race odds are released and useful.
risks.required_evidence: separate negative test + actual source bytes or documented simulated failure + independent recheck

risks.name: End-to-end no HTTP acceptance proves simulation only
risks.failure_mode: All unit cases may pass while real JRA HTML changes, violates rate controls or returns valid-looking error pages.
risks.required_evidence: separate negative test + actual source bytes or documented simulated failure + independent recheck

risks.name: Observed 12-race link or source HTML mismatch
risks.failure_mode: A previously tested synthetic source may not match the real JRA racecard or official race/day identity.
risks.required_evidence: Real captured official meeting and all 12 racecards, per-race raw SHA/UTC and counterexamples

risks.name: G03 source encryption, timestamp and incomplete-source attribution
risks.failure_mode: A new 12R capture file can be rejected by an encryption whitelist, dropped on interruption or mislabelled as completed.
risks.required_evidence: Live-source SHA/UTC and AES-GCM archive roundtrip with partial and interrupted captures

risks.name: All-horse G04 profile source identity, cutoff and historical leakage
risks.failure_mode: A profile source is fetched after the race cutoff, misbound to a runner or serialized without a recoverable original, or previously validated 12R provenance silently regresses.
risks.required_evidence: All real observed horse profiles with original bytes, SHA and UTC, cutoff, jockey/horse identifier gaps, no-data and nonfinish status

risks.name: G05 bodyweight weather and workout source completeness
risks.failure_mode: Live horse weights can be unpublished at first capture; training source may be inaccessible and missing values must not become zero, fabricated indicators or a prediction release.
risks.required_evidence: Source-dated per-race body-weight publication, actual workout source and missingness proof

risks.name: Kyoto turf/dirt weather and moisture stale measurement attribution
risks.failure_mode: The JRA track page may still contain previous-day/previous-meeting conditions. A weather/cushion/moisture value cannot be treated as current at prediction cutoff without source and published-as-of evidence.
risks.required_evidence: JRA Kyoto track page bytes, same-day heading, as-of observation timestamp, and pre-race source comparison

notes: Reverse FMEA explicitly finds risk modes not enumerated by the original 30 cases. Counting passing tests is not an independent proof of completeness.
